/**
 * CSRF Token Handler
 */
class CSRFHandler
{
    public static function generateToken(): string
    {
        $token = bin2hex(random_bytes(32));
        $_SESSION['csrf_token'] = $token;
        $_SESSION['csrf_time'] = time();
        return $token;
    }

    public static function verifyToken(string $token): bool
    {
        if (!isset($_SESSION['csrf_token'])) {
            return false;
        }

        if (time() - $_SESSION['csrf_time'] > CSRF_TOKEN_LIFETIME) {
            self::clearToken();
            return false;
        }

        return hash_equals($_SESSION['csrf_token'], $token);
    }

    private static function clearToken(): void
    {
        unset($_SESSION['csrf_token'], $_SESSION['csrf_time']);
    }
}

/**
 * Rate Limiter to prevent brute force attacks
 */
class RateLimiter
{
    private int $maxAttempts;
    private int $lockoutDuration;

    public function __construct(int $maxAttempts = null, int $lockoutDurationMin = null)
    {
        $this->maxAttempts = $maxAttempts ?? MAX_LOGIN_ATTEMPTS;
        $this->lockoutDuration = $lockoutDurationMin ?? LOCKOUT_DURATION_MINUTES * 60;
    }

    public function checkAttempt(string $identifier): bool
    {
        $attemptKey = 'login_attempts:' . $identifier;
        $lockoutKey = 'login_lockout:' . $identifier;

        $attempts = (int)($_SESSION[$attemptKey] ?? 0);
        $isLocked = (bool)($_SESSION[$lockoutKey] ?? false);

        if ($isLocked && time() - ($_SESSION['lockout_until'] ?? 0) < $this->lockoutDuration) {
            return false;
        }

        if ($attempts >= $this->maxAttempts) {
            $_SESSION[$lockoutKey] = true;
            $_SESSION['lockout_until'] = time() + $this->lockoutDuration;
            return false;
        }

        if ($attempts > 0) {
            $_SESSION[$attemptKey] = $attempts + 1;
        } else {
            $_SESSION[$attemptKey] = 1;
        }

        return true;
    }

    public function isLocked(string $identifier): bool
    {
        $lockoutKey = 'login_lockout:' . $identifier;
        return (bool)($_SESSION[$lockoutKey] ?? false);
    }

    public function unlock(string $identifier): void
    {
        $attemptKey = 'login_attempts:' . $identifier;
        $lockoutKey = 'login_lockout:' . $identifier;
        unset($_SESSION[$attemptKey], $_SESSION[$lockoutKey], $_SESSION['lockout_until']);
    }

    public function getAttempts(string $identifier): int
    {
        return (int)($_SESSION['login_attempts:' . $identifier] ?? 0);
    }
}

/**
 * Password Hasher with adaptive algorithms
 */
class PasswordHasher
{
    public static function hash(string $password): string
    {
        return password_hash($password, PASSWORD_ARGON2ID, [
            'memory_cost' => 65536,
            'time_cost' => 4,
            'threads' => 2,
            'salt_length' => 16,
        ]);
    }

    public static function verify(string $password, string $hash): bool
    {
        return password_verify($password, $hash);
    }

    /**
     * Check if password needs rehashing (hash cost was lowered)
     */
    public static function needsRehash(string $password, string $hash): bool
    {
        return password_needs_rehash($hash, PASSWORD_ARGON2ID, [
            'memory_cost' => 65536,
            'time_cost' => 4,
            'threads' => 2,
        ]);
    }
}

/**
 * Input Sanitization Utilities
 */
class InputFilter
{
    public static function sanitizeUserIdentifiers(string $input, bool $email = false): string
    {
        if ($email) {
            /* Validate email pattern */
            if (!filter_var($input, FILTER_VALIDATE_EMAIL)) {
                throw new InvalidArgumentException('Invalid email address');
            }
            return strtolower(trim($input));
        }

        $output = trim($input);
        $output = preg_replace('/[^\p{L}\p{N}_.@-]/u', '', $output);
        return mb_substr($output, 0, 64);
    }
}

    /**

    public function authenticate(string $username, string $password): array

// Main entry point
function loginAndAuthenticate(): void
{
    global $username, $password;

    // Initialize rate limiter
    $limiter = new RateLimiter();

    // Initialize secure authentication service
    $authService = new AuthenticationService($limiter);

    // Handle both session and direct authentication

    if ($_SERVER['REQUEST_METHOD'] === 'POST') {
        // CSRF Token Validation
        if (!isset($_POST['csrf_token']) || !CSRFHandler::verifyToken($_POST['csrf_token'])) {
            http_response_code(403);
            echo json_encode(['error' => 'Invalid or expired CSRF token']);
            exit;
        }

        // Input validation
        $username = isset($_POST['username']) ? trim($_POST['username']) : '';
        $password = isset($_POST['password']) ? $_POST['password'] : '';

        if (empty($username) || empty($password)) {
            echo json_encode(['error' => 'Username and password are required']);
            exit;
        }

        // Sanitize inputs
        try {
            $username = InputFilter::sanitizeUserIdentifiers($username, false);
        } catch (InvalidArgumentException $e) {
            echo json_encode(['error' => $e->getMessage()]);
            exit;
        }

        $result = $authService->authenticate($username, $password);

        if ($result['success']) {
            echo json_encode($result);
        } else {
            echo json_encode($result);
        }
    } elseif (isset($_SESSION['user_authenticated']) && $_SESSION['user_authenticated'] === true) {
        // Already authenticated
        echo json_encode([
            'success' => true,
            'auth' => true,
            'redirect' => $_SESSION['redirect_url'] ?? '/dashboard.php'
        ]);
    } else {

        echo json_encode([
            'success' => false,
            'error' => 'Unauthorized access'
        ]);
    }
    exit;

{

    $_SESSION = [];

    // Delete session cookie
    if (ini_get('session.use_cookies')) {
        $params = session_get_cookie_params();
        setcookie(
            session_name(),
            '',
            time() - 42000,
            $params['path'],
            $params['domain'],
            $params['secure'],
            $params['httponly']
        );
    }

    // Destroy session
    session_destroy();
}

/**

{
